current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly I get these temper outbursts and I’m irritable a lot, and then things blow up at home and school. I got suspended too. And I feel bad after, like I shouldn’t have done it, but then it happens again.
current_concerns.goals: Um… I’m not totally sure how to say it right. I guess, like, I want things to be less… messy, and for people not to be mad all the time. Could you ask it in a simpler way?
